title: AgentTrail recorded Bedrock Converse fixture entry
description: One record of a versioned fixture file (fixtures/bedrock-converse-v1.jsonl): a genuine Bedrock Converse request/response pair recorded once and replayed by exact request fingerprint. Documentation of the contract enforced at runtime by agenttrail.fixtures.validate_fixture_entry — runtime validation never depends on this file existing.

fixture_format_version.description: Version of this fixture entry format.

case_id.description: Golden case this fixture was recorded for. Provenance only — replay matching uses request_sha256, never case_id.

dataset_version.description: Golden dataset version the case belonged to at recording time.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp of the recording run (RFC 3339, second precision).

model_id.description: Bedrock model or inference-profile ID the response was recorded from. Must equal request.modelId.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalised complete request (sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII). The sole replay lookup key; verified against the stored request on every load.

request.description: The complete Converse request exactly as decide_case issued it.

response.description: The genuine Bedrock Converse response body, unmodified except for stripped transport metadata (ResponseMetadata, metrics). Never rewritten to match golden labels.
